intro: What Comes Next marks the culmination of affairs on Zephras Isle as travelers prepare to depart across the skies. With the local cult threat quelled and High Elder Shadowsong's blessing secured, skycutter transport is opened between the island and the plains of Mulgore.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm pleased to hear that we have High Elder Shadowsong's blessing for our expedition. Now that the cult has been defeated and preparations have been made, I think it's finally time.

Muln has worked diligently to help us get stable skycutter transport going between Zephras Isle and a place called Mulgore, where the Earthen Ring make their home. We've been doing test voyages and some of our people are already waiting on the other side.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
